_about: Stat-based tiles (TDs, kicking, drafted-player points, margin) are computed from Yahoo API weekly data over starters, weeks 1-16 (2020's full season length, applied uniformly) — see yahooFantasyAPIcaller/scripts/computeRecords.js. Verified vs API Aug 2026. Caveat: Yahoo zeroes weekly stat lines ~3+ seasons back, so TD counts for 2020-2021 are unrecoverable — the 116 TD record is the legacy 2020 value and 2021 can never be checked. Fantasy points survive for all seasons, so kicking/drafted/margin tiles cover full league history.
